want to be honest I’m critical old school but young still:)  if I’m desperate I get appointments. Jot all staff are great that’s true it looks like you have forced some to be there. However the physio is exceptional the doctors don’t just tend to hand you any old thing. Some are genuinely interested in how you are feeling I’ve had that on more than one occasion. I’ve had much worse surgeries in bilston such as bilson health centre. Often things can be out and f the person on the desks control. That’s why I’ve never got angry with them. They don’t get paid enough. Your health isn’t worth the stress with that and I get stressed easily very easy. The only thing I can advise is message them phone or arrive on same day before 8 am they have always tried their best with me and that’s the receptionists across all the surgeries not one or two each one has always tried to get an appointment so it’s not like they would know me personally I guess I’m trying to say. I can only suggest this. Times are changing we no longer get family doctors. They see loads a day. Yes I agree they get paid enough. One doctor though actually made me think differently he pointed out a truth. Last year not even year ago I was in hospital passed out with blood pressure of 200. Ended up in icu. Always known blood pressure issues so hospital should kept me in they sent me home as I woke up told me it was stress. My doctor pointed out I couldn’t have had a panic attack whilst unconscious that that’s what’s known as a symptomatic heart attack.
It made sense I don’t remember much but I know I wernt panicking as I was only at 111 I though I had a water infection and was weekend.they told me go see my doctor and as my doctor rightly pointed out. How can I monitor your blood p24 hours I can’t come home with you. I can’t xray you. I can’t send blood test to reception and get back within hour . I can only do so much. In all honesty they changed over years of the way I thought. I thought that’s right he has a point. Sometimes though I get it it’s easier to blame who’s in front of you. Unfortunately when they refer you or it’s something out of their control it becomes a complaint.

a patient of this surgery for over 30 years, since birth and how I miss the Dr Julka days. Now this “Health and Beyond” group is a shambles, almost impossible to get an appt unless you’re almost on your death bed, and even then it’s weeks ahead or they’re advising you to go to New Cross if you need more urgent care. And let’s not talk about the ridiculous call wait times then as if it couldn’t get worse now they've introduced an online booking system which is only available to use for a very limited time at 7:30 am. It’s not a user friendly way to request a gp appt, and certainly not convenient or even practical for a lot of people I.e elderly. There’s a big assumption being made that everyone is PC literate and has internet/wifi. As for the receptionists, I agree with other comments about them being rude and lacking empathy.
